courierLocation.description: Only with dispatch: where the courier is, trimmed 1..60 chars (validated by set_delivery_status).

failedCount.description: Deliveries currently failed that failed today.

averageDeliveryMinutes.description: Average dispatched_at → delivered_at of the delivered ones, rounded minutes; null without any.

amountDue.description: subtotal + tax (no delivery fee, no tip).

id.description: Profile id (the :id of the staff routes).

userId.description: Login identity; null for a legacy profile without login.

email.description: Login email (profile email for a legacy profile).

hasPin.description: The member has a PIN (shared terminal, supervisor authorization).

pinLockedUntil.description: End of a running PIN lockout (5 failures lock 5 minutes); null when not locked.
End of a running PIN lockout, for an admin caller only (always null for other callers); null when not locked.

pin.description: 4-6 digits; not one repeated digit, a run (1234, 4321) or a repeated block (1212).

date.description: Calendar day in the restaurant timezone.

amount.description: Sum of the paid orders created that day.

id.description: A dish id sold under that name, if any.

name.description: Item name as sold (the grouping key).

monthSales.description: Sum of `total` of the paid orders created since the first day of the month (restaurant timezone).

dailySales.description: Days with paid sales since local midnight `days` days back, oldest first (days without sales are absent).

popularDishes.description: Paid items in the same window grouped by name, most units first (ties by name), at most 10.

contentType.description: image/* except SVG. The PUT must send this exact Content-Type.

size.description: Bytes. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Length.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL, valid for 5 minutes, bound to the declared Content-Type and size.

publicUrl.description: Public read URL of the object once uploaded; store it as the dish imageUrl.
A publicUrl from POST /storage/uploads; must be under S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL and the caller's restaurant.

kind.description: prep: receives comanda lines; cashier: Caja, facturas and precuentas.

isDefault.description: The prep station that receives dishes without a route (the first one created).

dishCount.description: Dishes of the category, active or not.

stationId.description: The exception; null = same as the category.

routedStationId.description: Where its lines go now; null without prep stations.

dishes.description: By category order, then dish order and name.

unroutedDishes.description: Active dishes that go to the default station only because nothing routes them.

stationId.description: A prep station; null clears the route.

moveTo.description: Prep station that takes the routes.

branch.description: The restaurant name when business_name differs, else empty.

deviceToken.description: `vdt_…`, returned only here; send it as `Authorization: Bearer`.

updateRequired.description: Present (true) when DESKTOP_RELEASES_BASE_URL is set and the app is older than the newest required release of its channel and target.

kind.description: cashier for Caja; other for every prep station.

profileId.description: Ignored (stored as null) unless staff of the restaurant.

status.description: From the last heartbeat; null when not reported.

online.description: Not revoked and seen within the last 90 seconds.
